slowestQueries.sql: SELECT "c"."Name", COALESCE(ef_sum(ef_multiply(CAST("s"."Qty" AS REAL), "s"."UnitPrice")), '0.0') AS "Value"  FROM "SalesItems" AS "s"  INNER JOIN "SalesInvoices" AS "s0" ON "s"."SalesInvoiceId" = "s0"."Id"  INNER JOIN "Products" AS "p" ON "s"."ProductId" = "p"."Id"  INNER JOIN "Categories" AS "c" ON "p"."CategoryId" = "c"."Id"  WHERE NOT ("s0"."IsDeleted") AND "s0"."Status" <> 4 AND "s0"."ShopId" = @shopIds1 AND "s0"."InvoiceDate" >= @start AND "s0"."InvoiceDate" < @endExclusive  GROUP BY "c"."Name"

SELECT "p"."Name", COALESCE(ef_sum(ef_multiply(CAST("s"."Qty" AS REAL), "s"."UnitPrice")), '0.0') AS "Value"  FROM "SalesItems" AS "s"  INNER JOIN "SalesInvoices" AS "s0" ON "s"."SalesInvoiceId" = "s0"."Id"  INNER JOIN "Products" AS "p" ON "s"."ProductId" = "p"."Id"  WHERE NOT ("s0"."IsDeleted") AND "s0"."Status" <> 4 AND "s0"."ShopId" = @shopIds1 AND "s0"."InvoiceDate" >= @start AND "s0"."InvoiceDate" < @endExclusive  GROUP BY "p"."Name"

SELECT "u2"."Id", "u2"."CreatedAt", "u2"."CreatedBy", "u2"."FullName", "u2"."IsActive", "u2"."IsDeleted", "u2"."LastLoginAt", "u2"."PasswordHash", "u2"."Role", "u2"."TokenVersion", "u2"."UpdatedAt", "u2"."UpdatedBy", "u2"."Username", "s0"."Id", "s0"."ShopId", "s0"."UserId", "s0"."Id0", "s0"."Address", "s0"."Code", "s0"."CreatedAt", "s0"."CreatedBy", "s0"."IsActive", "s0"."IsDeleted", "s0"."Name", "s0"."Phone", "s0"."UpdatedAt", "s0"."UpdatedBy", "u1"."Id", "u1"."CanRead", "u1"."CanWrite", "u1"."Module", "u1"."UserId"  FROM (      SELECT "u"."Id", "u"."CreatedAt", "u"."CreatedBy", "u"."FullName", "u"."IsActive", "u"."IsDeleted", "u"."LastLoginAt", "u"."PasswordHash", "u"."Role", "u"."TokenVersion", "u"."UpdatedAt", "u"."UpdatedBy", "u"."Username"      FROM "Users" AS "u"      WHERE "u"."Username" = @request_Username AND NOT ("u"."IsDeleted")      LIMIT 1  ) AS "u2"  LEFT JOIN (      SELECT "u0"."Id", "u0"."ShopId", "u0"."UserId", "s"."Id" AS "Id0", "s"."Address", "s"."Code", "s"."CreatedAt", "s"."CreatedBy", "s"."IsActive", "s"."IsDeleted", "s"."Name", "s"."Phone", "s"."UpdatedAt", "s"."UpdatedBy"      FROM "UserShops" AS "u0"      INNER JOIN "Shops" AS "s" ON "u0"."ShopId" = "s"."Id"  ) AS "s0" ON "u2"."Id" = "s0"."UserId"  LEFT JOIN "UserPermissions" AS "u1" ON "u2"."Id" = "u1"."UserId"  ORDER BY "u2"."Id", "s0"."Id", "s0"."Id0"
SELECT "s"."InvoiceNo"  FROM "SalesInvoices" AS "s"  WHERE "s"."ShopId" = @shopId AND "s"."InvoiceNo" LIKE @prefix_startswith ESCAPE '\'
SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM "SalesInvoices" AS "s"  WHERE NOT ("s"."IsDeleted") AND "s"."ShopId" = @shopIds1

SELECT COALESCE(ef_sum(CASE      WHEN "p"."Direction" = 1 THEN "p"."Amount"      ELSE ef_negate("p"."Amount")  END), '0.0')  FROM "PettyCashEntries" AS "p"  WHERE NOT ("p"."IsDeleted") AND "p"."ShopId" = @shopIds1 AND "p"."EntryDate" < @asAt

SELECT "p0"."Id", "p0"."Sku", "p0"."Name", "c"."Name" AS "CategoryName", "p0"."SalePrice", (      SELECT COALESCE(SUM("s"."Qty"), 0)      FROM "StockLevels" AS "s"      WHERE "s"."ProductId" = "p0"."Id" AND "s"."ShopId" = @shopId) AS "Qty"  FROM (      SELECT "p"."Id", "p"."CategoryId", "p"."Name", "p"."SalePrice", "p"."Sku"      FROM "Products" AS "p"      WHERE "p"."IsActive" AND NOT ("p"."IsDeleted") AND ("p"."Sku" LIKE @needle OR "p"."Name" LIKE @needle OR ("p"."Brand" IS NOT NULL AND "p"."Brand" LIKE @needle))      ORDER BY "p"."Name"      LIMIT @p  ) AS "p0"  INNER JOIN "Categories" AS "c" ON "p0"."CategoryId" = "c"."Id"  ORDER BY "p0"."Name"
SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM "StockLevels" AS "s"  INNER JOIN "Products" AS "p" ON "s"."ProductId" = "p"."Id"  WHERE "s"."ShopId" = @shopIds1 AND NOT ("p"."IsDeleted")
SELECT COUNT(*)  FROM "Products" AS "p"  WHERE NOT ("p"."IsDeleted")
